ViewerCapabilityAuth.description: Ephemeral viewer-only capability; not an agent access key.

BearerAuth.description: Bearer token matching CAMOFOX_API_KEY (per-route auth for sensitive endpoints like cookie import and traces).

AccessKeyAuth.description: Bearer token matching CAMOFOX_ACCESS_KEY. When set, gates all routes except /health, cookie import, and /stop. Acts as a superkey -- also accepted by endpoints that normally require CAMOFOX_API_KEY.

post.summary: Attach a file to an upload control
post.description: Attaches files from the configured upload directory without going through the native OS file dialog. Set CAMOFOX_UPLOADS_DIR to a directory that contains the files (default: ~/.camofox/uploads). Two strategies are tried in order: (1) if an <input type="file"> is already present, call Playwright setInputFiles on it directly (works for hidden inputs); (2) otherwise arm a filechooser listener, activate the trigger element (ref or selector) via keyboard (focus + Enter) then a forced click as fallback, and call setFiles on the resulting chooser. Each path must be an absolute path that resolves inside the configured upload directory.

path.description: Absolute path, or array of paths, that resolves within CAMOFOX_UPLOADS_DIR.

ref.description: Trigger element ref (e.g. e36). Optional when an input[type=file] already exists.

selector.description: Trigger element CSS/Playwright selector. Optional when an input[type=file] already exists.

timeout.description: Overall budget in ms to wait for an upload UI (in-app panel input or native file chooser) to appear after the trigger is activated. Ignored values (non-numeric or <= 0) fall back to the default.

400.description: Bad request (missing path/userId; non-regular file; or a path that is missing or outside the configured upload directory).

post.description: Types text into a focused element or a specific ref/selector.

409.description: Page changed or target became invalid; caller should take a fresh snapshot and retry.

post.summary: Evaluate JavaScript in tab
post.description: Runs arbitrary JS in the page context and returns the result.

409.description: Page navigated while evaluating; caller should retry once the page settles.

503.description: Browser session expired; caller should retry to get a fresh session.

post.summary: Structured data extraction via JSON Schema
post.description:
Extracts structured data from the current page using a JSON Schema whose properties
carry `x-ref` hints pointing at snapshot element refs (e.g. `e1`, `e2`).  
Call `GET /tabs/{tabId}/snapshot` first to populate the ref table.

schema.description:
JSON Schema with `type: "object"` and a `properties` map.  
Each property may include `x-ref` (a snapshot element ref) and an optional
`type` (`string`, `number`, `integer`, `boolean`).

required.description: Property names that must resolve to a non-null value.

data.description: Extracted key-value pairs matching the input schema.

400.description: Missing userId, missing schema, or invalid schema.

409.description: No refs available -- call snapshot first.

422.description: Extraction failed (e.g. required ref not found).
